parse-multiline-blank-fill: Genuine, confirmed cross-parser divergence (Task 6). extractEditBlocks() (TS) bakes normalizeProposals() into its own return value (src/parseEditBlocks.ts:400-406 returns `blocks: finalBlocks` where `finalBlocks = normalizeProposals(blocks)`), so it is impossible to observe pre-normalization output through the public API -- extractEditBlocks(prose).blocks for this input is [{"action":"replace_all","target_text":"Signed by: [__]","new_text":"Signed by: Suzy Quatro"},{"action":"replace_all","target_text":"Title: [__]","new_text":"Title: Chief Executive Officer"}]. skills/legal_research/edit_parsing.py's _extract_proposed_edits (Python) has no splitMultilineFieldEdits counterpart and never splits a multi-line replace, so it returns the original single edit: [{"action":"replace","target_text":"Signed by: [__]\nTitle: [__]","new_text":"Signed by: Suzy Quatro\nTitle: Chief Executive Officer"}]. Not a data-entry mistake -- 1 edit vs 2, different shape entirely. Never edit parseEditBlocks.ts or edit_parsing.py to resolve this (out of scope for Task 6); a same-language fix is a separate branch.
